title: Yellowed German Cheddar Casserole
description: A fatty and light festive German dish featuring mature cheddar, this casserole is perfect for special occasions, served on a traditional talavera plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded cheddar, blanched spinach, and sauteed onion mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter and eggs.
Add the bread cubes to the egg mixture and toss until the bread is well coated.
Add the bread mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a talavera plate and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
